description: Daily Display ad request and non-zero-response volume for a marketplace over a period, one row per day. Exposes date with requests (ad requests received) and responses (requests that returned at least one ad); the Python layer derives total_requests, total_responses, avg_response_percentage, and days_count.

date.description: The calendar day the Display ad requests were received (per-day row).

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Display ad requests received on this day.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN auf.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Display ad requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) on this day.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_ad_unit_facts` AS auf JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON auf.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND auf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND auf.page_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(auf.page_type) NOT IN ('', 'NA') AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
